lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Reward: Elysion VIP Buffet Voucher ×2

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Hi, friend!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: This is my way of apologizing

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: for not living up to my promise of giving you an awesome experience.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But rest assured,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: next time I'll show you the majestic beauty that Raptures possess!
Why do you admire Raptures so much?
Don't you ever feel like your life is in danger?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Sure, I do.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: But I won't let that dissuade me.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: I've always loved animals since I was a child!

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Of course, most scholars wouldn't categorize

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Raptures as animals per se,

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: but who says we can't expand the definition of that word?
I'm sorry, but it's rather difficult to relate to all this.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: For now, I'm sure it is.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: After all, you've never been shown their beautiful side.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: Have you seen a group of Raptures all moving together single file

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: under the warm glow of the setting sun?

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: It's like traveling back in time to the savannahs of the past.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: One day, I'll have you see that spectacular view with your own eyes.

lines.speaker: raptilion
lines.text: As for now, I have to get going!
